verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documentation directly covers the story: importing robots/environments (URDF/MJCF/CAD/USD), physics simulation via PhysX/Newton, RTX and physics-based sensors, synthetic data generation, and ROS 2 validation before hardware deployment, with GitHub docs confirming asset import and robot tuning for physics accuracy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks validating sensor/physics realism claims (community evidence found only concerns the separate GR00T model, not simulation fidelity itself).
